name: Monotonic Stack
tagline: Next Greater Element in O(n) Time
coreIdea: A stack maintained strictly in monotonic (increasing or decreasing) order. Whenever a new element violates the order, you pop until the condition holds.
whenToUse: Find the next greater/smaller element for every element

name: Trie (Prefix Tree)
tagline: Blazing fast prefix queries and autocomplete
coreIdea: A tree where each node represents a character. Shared prefixes share branches, enabling O(L) search time where L is word length.
